decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12pt">The proposed first-floor front extension, associated roof alterations&nbsp;and increased roof ridge height, by reason of their inappropriate form and design, would result in an obtrusive and conspicuous addition. The development would form an unsympathetic extension to the building, disrupting the symmetry of the semi-detached pair and appearing at odds with the character of the host dwelling and the prevailing streetscape. Consequently, the proposal would cause harm to the character and appearance of the area, contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D.1 and D.11) of the London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), policy CS1 B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012)&nbsp;and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).</span></span></p>
description: First floor front to side extension, Single storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to raise ridge height, Roof lights in front and rear roof slopes, Alterations to roof of front extension, External alterations (Demolition of rear extension)
